invariants.rationale: The method immediately throws a NullPointerException if style is null, so this invariant always holds at method exit.
style.wrapWidth is accessed without null-check, so style and wrapWidth are valid; the code logic handles both cases.
style.background is set as container background, meaning it is accessed safely and could be either value.
style.label is set into label without null-check, so it is safe to access but may be null or not.
